title.narrative: Stronger Systems to Protect Child Victims of OCSE

description.narrative: This seeks to protect children of all ages& gender in the target communities in the Philippines from online sexual exploitation. Specifically, this focused on strengthening local CPS at various levels to address OCSE. To achieve this, local governments will be influenced & capacitated to sustainably implement programmes & deliver appropriate services to child victims. This includes strengthening CPMs & building the capacities of the social service work force & dutybearers to provide OCSE related information & services to be facilitated thru referral pathways.
